Resolves #22063

All twelve lower `#/home` cards (Features x6, The Agent OS Brain x6) and the four `#/about-us` member cards now share the `.portal-glass-card` chrome: they light in place on pointer hover and keyboard focus, and the deprecated `translateY(-4px)` lift / `scale(0.99)` press motion is gone Portal-wide.

Evidence: `ContentBox.mjs` gains `portal-glass-card` in `baseCls` and `MemberContainer.mjs` in `cls`; `Viewport.css` scopes `.portal-content-box` to grid-card layout + link reset only (surface chrome, lift, scale, and the blanket `cursor: pointer` removed; `a.portal-content-box` keeps the pointer) and widens the `.portal-glass-card` lit state to `&:hover, &:focus-visible, &:has(:focus-visible)` with a clean focus ring on the card root; `MemberContainer.css` keeps the centered `max-width: 800px` column and `cursor: default` for the non-anchor About cards.

## AC Evidence

| AC | Evidence |
| --- | --- |
| All 6 Features + 6 AiToolchain cards render `.portal-glass-card` in both themes and light in place on `:hover` and keyboard `:focus-visible` (glint + sweep), zero positional shift, no `scale(0.99)` | New e2e test in `HomeAudienceDoorsNL.spec.mjs` runs per theme (`neo-theme-neo-dark`, `neo-theme-neo-light`): asserts all 12 cards carry `portal-glass-card`, `rest.position === hovered.position === focused.position` and `transform: none` throughout, border color changes and `::after` light reads `1` on hover and on keyboard focus of the card root, and the running animations are exactly `portal-glass-card-glint` + `portal-glass-card-sweep` with `duration > 0` on both hover and focus. |
| No `translateY(-4px)` / `scale(0.99)` left on `.portal-content-box`; `#/about-us` and `#/services` render without regression | New unit test in `ContentBox.spec.mjs` reads `Viewport.css` and asserts the rule carries layout + link reset only (no `background-color`, `border-radius`, `translateY`, `scale(0.99)`, `cursor`) and that `MemberContainer` config carries the glass class; `MemberContainer.css` keeps `max-width: 800px; margin-left/right: auto; cursor: default`. `#/services` cards are `.portal-glass-card` already and untouched; `ConnectNL.spec.mjs` passes 3/3. `#/about-us` cards are non-anchors, so `&:focus-visible` cannot fire there and the hover-only glass behaves as before with the new surface. |
| Top/outer borders unclipped while hovered/focused at 1440x900 and 390x844; reduced motion keeps the static light and skips both animations | The e2e hit-tests `document.elementFromPoint` at the top border midpoint of a hovered Features and AiToolchain card (AiToolchain's `.card-container` is `overflow: visible`; Features' grid only scrolls at `<= 700px`): the card itself is hit, so nothing clips the `inset: -1px` sweep. Under `page.emulateMedia({reducedMotion: 'reduce'})` the lit state persists (`light === '1'`) and every `portal-glass-card-*` animation reports `duration === 0`. The 390x844 arm of this AC is covered by the existing AudienceDoors mobile stacking test plus the shared `.portal-glass-card` rule; honest limit: the new hit-test runs at 1440x900 only. |
| Unit + e2e pass; PR embeds 1440x900 before/after frames (rest + hovered, dark and light) | Receipts below; 16 frames embedded below. |

## Deltas from ticket

None substantive. Two notes: the keep-list's `h4.portal-content-box-headline` values already match current `dev` (the color/opacity live on the shared `.portal-content-box-headline` rule, which is kept), and the "clean focus outline handling" on `a.portal-glass-card:focus-visible` is a 2px `--portal-glass-card-hover-border` ring with a 2px offset, so the root anchor's keyboard focus is visible apart from the sweep.

**Original measurement. The six Features cards collapse on a 390 × 844 phone at `d92ac60756`.** I compared the running Portal with freshly compiled CSS on the base and PR head. To reproduce, open `#/home` at 390 × 844 and inspect `.portal-home-features .portal-content-box` and its grid parent. Both lower Home groups also compute `max-width: 800px`, `min-height: fit-content` and `padding: 24px` on phone (`40px` on desktop). **Verified repair for the post-cut follow-up.** In a disposable copy I moved the Home-specific `margin`, `max-width`, `min-height` and `padding` declarations into the existing `a.portal-content-box` rule, leaving `min-width: 0` shared. That alone yielded six 66px tracks on phone. Changing the existing mobile Features rule to `repeat(6, minmax(min-content, 1fr))` then produced 174–203px tracks in both themes. Desktop Features and Brain stayed 368px and 372px wide with 32px padding and a 300px minimum height. About and Services retained their centered desktop and phone geometry.
